description.value: Grounds & Greens Cafe is a family-owned, fully plant-based cafe run by chefs Mannel and Ben Kilford, located in the heart of historic Fort Langley village. The menu centres on hearty power bowls, toasties, wraps, and bites made with locally sourced ingredients — substantial fuel for a cycling day. The cafe has eliminated single-use containers in favour of reusables as part of a zero-waste commitment.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An operating vegan cafe with outdoor seating in the heart of Fort Langley, a well-known cycling destination on the Fort-to-Fort trail. The hearty bowl-and-coffee menu suits touring cyclists, and the sustainability ethos aligns with cycling tourism values.
